#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        vector<long long> factorial;
        vector<long long> invFactorial;

        virtual long long modulus() = 0;

        Modulus() {
            factorial.push_back(1);
            invFactorial.push_back(1);
        }

        long long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.size() <= n) {
                factorial.push_back(factorial.back() * factorial.size());
            }

            return factorial[n];
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;

            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = fInv[i - 1] * (n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push_back(fInv[i]);
                }
            }

            return invFactorial[n];
        }

        long long paritySign(long k) {
            return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : modulus() - 1;
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            assert(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r)
                return 0;
            return fact(n) * (fInv(r) * fInv(n - r));
        }

        long long normalize(long x) {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0)
                x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long a, long b) {
            long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long long mult(long long... x) {
            long long r = 1;
            for (long long i : x)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long pow(long long x, int e) {
            if (e < 0) {
                x = inv(x);
                e *= -1;
            }
            if (e == 0)
                return 1;
            if ((e & 1) > 0)
                return mult(x, pow(x, e - 1));
            return pow(mult(x, x), e / 2);
        }

        long long inv(long value) {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());

            return normalize(x);
        }

    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() override {
            return 998244353;
        }

    };

};

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {}
    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {}

    string next() {
        while (tokenizer == nullptr || !tokenizer->empty()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader);
            } catch (const exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error(e.what());
            }
        }
        return tokenizer->nextToken();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }

private:
    istream& reader;
    StringTokenizer* tokenizer;
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    long long k = in.nextLong();
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod.fact(n) << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int c = (int)(n - k);
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
        long long term = mod.paritySign(c - i) * mod.ncr(c, i) * pow(i, n);
        answer = mod.add(answer, term);
    }

    answer = mod.mult(answer, 2, mod.ncr(n, c));
    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}

class StringTokenizer {
public:
    StringTokenizer(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {}
    string nextToken() {
        while (tokenizer == nullptr || !tokenizer->empty()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new string(reader);
            } catch (const exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error(e.what());
            }
        }
        return tokenizer->next();
    }

private:
    istream& reader;
    string* tokenizer;
};

long long pow(long long x, int e) {
    if (e < 0) {
        x = NumberTheory::Mod998().inv(x);
        e *= -1;
    }
    if (e == 0)
        return 1;
    if ((e & 1) > 0)
        return x * pow(x, e - 1);
    return pow(x * x, e / 2);
}
